card.line: Paddan-aram was the region around Haran, home of Rebekah's family, where Jacob was sent to find a wife and where most of his sons were born.

moments.title: Jacob is sent to Paddan-aram
moments.text: Isaac told Jacob not to marry a Canaanite woman. He sent Jacob to Paddan-aram, to the house of Bethuel, to take a wife from the daughters of Laban.

moments.title: Jacob's sons are born
moments.text: Jacob had twelve sons. Genesis says the sons of Leah, Rachel, Bilhah, and Zilpah were born to him in Paddan-aram.

moments.title: Jacob leaves with his family
moments.text: Jacob put his children and wives on camels and drove his livestock ahead of him. He took all the possessions he had gained in Paddan-aram and set out for his father Isaac in Canaan.
